description: React component 'A2AMetrics' that displays metadata and metrics related to an 'A2A' task, including status, timestamps, latency, IDs, and optional detailed information.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on the task status.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string for the status badge based on the task status.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into a locale-specific time string.

methods.name: truncateId
methods.description: Shortens a long ID string to a specified length with an ellipsis.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided text to the clipboard.
